title: Stormer Tweaks
description: Makes the grind a little easier by changing crafting, loot tables, enchanting, etc.
body:
# Stormer Tweaks
Makes the grind a little easier by changing crafting, loot tables, enchanting, etc.

- Crafting outputs more blocks so you can spend more time on building and less on gathering resources.
- Rail now makes 64 so minecarts can be a more viable option for transportation.
- A few crafting recipes are shapeless for convenience.
- More universal dying.
- Crafting recipes changed to be more consistent throughout the game.
- Some items are now able to be crafted.
- Some blocks can now be smelted in the blast furnace to save time.
- Increased XP from blasting and smoking.
- Some block and mob loot table changes.
- Enchantments are no longer exclusive (example: infinity and mending can now both be on a bow).
- Most enchantments max out at level 1 to make villager farms unnecessary.
- Music discs, paintings, and goat horns can be put in the stonecutter to get other variants.

Read "About Pack.txt" for full list of changes.
